description: This is a migration script for the Superset project, specifically for renaming form data fields in visualization slices related to 'big_number_total'. It contains database schema modifications and data transformation logic for upgrade and downgrade operations.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Represents a visualization slice in the database with id, params, and viz_type fields.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs data migration to rename specific fields in slice parameters for slices with viz_type 'big_number_total'.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the parameter renaming performed in upgrade for slices with viz_type 'big_number_total'.
